captions.caption: A crew member's silhouette watches a hovercraft approach a ship through a misty opening.
The hovercraft kicks up a massive spray of water as it maneuvers toward the ship's well deck.
Mist and spray surround the hovercraft as it lines up with the ship's entrance.
The hovercraft continues its approach, with the crew member standing still in the foreground.
The outline of the hovercraft becomes clearer as it moves closer to the ship.
Waves and spray from the hovercraft's fans are visible as it enters the ship's wake.
The hovercraft begins to cross the threshold into the ship's docking area.
Dense white spray fills the air as the hovercraft moves into the well deck.
The front of the hovercraft enters the ship, partially obscured by the mist it creates.
The hovercraft glides further into the ship, its large size becoming apparent.
The crew member in silhouette watches as the hovercraft's bow enters the dark interior.
The hovercraft continues its steady progress into the ship's well deck.
More of the hovercraft's structure is visible as it moves away from the bright opening.
The hovercraft's fans continue to generate spray even as it moves further inside.
The hovercraft is now halfway into the ship's docking area.
The hovercraft's large fans are clearly visible through the dissipating spray.
The hovercraft moves slowly toward its final parking position inside the ship.
The mist begins to clear inside the well deck as the hovercraft settles.
The hovercraft is almost fully inside the ship, with the crew member still watching.
The hovercraft completes its entrance and begins to settle onto the deck.
The hovercraft comes to a halt inside the well deck, surrounded by swirling mist.
A wide shot shows the hovercraft entering the ship's well deck from a distance.
Silhouetted crew members stand in the foreground as the hovercraft moves into position.
The hovercraft's headlights and fans are visible as it advances through the well deck.
The hovercraft creates a strong breeze and spray as it moves toward the interior.
Crew members in silhouette monitor the hovercraft's movement from the sides.
The hovercraft's air cushion begins to deflate as it reaches its designated spot.
The hovercraft settles onto the ship's deck, with the bright ocean in the background.
Mist and spray continue to swirl around the hovercraft as its engines wind down.
A crew member in silhouette signals to the hovercraft as it comes to a complete stop.
Two silhouetted crew members are shown from behind, preparing to guide the hovercraft.
One crew member raises two orange signaling wands to direct the hovercraft.
The crew member makes precise movements with the wands to guide the hovercraft forward.
The hovercraft looms in the background, its fans creating a dense mist around the crew.
The signaling crew member continues to provide directions with the orange wands.
The hovercraft moves closer to the crew members, its massive structure filling the frame.
The crew member raises the wands high, signaling the hovercraft to stop or adjust.
The hovercraft's fans are still spinning, blowing mist past the silhouetted crew.
The crew members stand their ground as the hovercraft finishes its maneuver.
The hovercraft is now stationary, and the crew member continues to hold the signal.
The crew member lowers the signaling wands as the hovercraft's engines throttle down.
The spray begins to clear from the area around the parked hovercraft.
The two crew members remain in silhouette, observing the now-stationary hovercraft.
The hovercraft is fully settled on the deck, and the air inside the ship calms.
One crew member raises the signaling wands again for a brief moment.
The hovercraft's large fans are seen slowing down in the background.
The crew member makes a final signal with the wands before lowering them completely.
The crew members stand still, their task of guiding the hovercraft finished.
The hovercraft is securely parked in the well deck, with mist still lingering.
The silhouetted figures of the crew are framed by the bright light from the stern.
The crew members continue to watch the hovercraft as it is secured by other teams.
The hovercraft is now completely static, its fans stopped and the spray gone.
The crew members adjust their positions, their work for this arrival concluded.
The scene stays on the silhouetted crew members against the backdrop of the hovercraft.
The massive scale of the hovercraft is evident as it sits behind the crew.
The crew members remain in place, ensuring the hovercraft is safely docked.
Light from the ship's opening highlights the silhouettes of the two crew members.
The crew members begin to move away from their signaling positions.
The hovercraft is now a stable part of the ship's internal cargo.
The final shot shows the crew members standing in the quiet well deck after the landing.
